      "review_text": "This place is horrible! The bouncers were incredibly rude and saying disturbing things to me.     {
      "review_stars": 1.0,
      "review_date": "2021-11-15 17:44:26",
      "review_text": "My son was a groomsman at a wedding in Santa Barbara on October 10, 2021, a Sunday night. DO NOT PATRONIZE THIS BAR, their employees are dishonest and thieves."
    },
    {
      "review_stars": 5.0,
      "review_date": "2021-08-11 23:42:10",
      "review_text": "I know, I know.... People might be shocked to see that O'Malley's gets a five star rating from me.   More on that later.  \n\nO'Malley's is hard to categorize which I believe is the reason it is not carrying a higher Yelp rating.   I would describe it as a \"neighborhood bar located at ground zero of tourist central\".  Some would call it a dive bar, it isn't.   I am a bit of a dive bar connoisseur and O'Malley's falls short or more accurately elevates above the standard of dive bar.   Mostly for the lack of bar flys sitting at the counter at 11:00am.  \n\nThey have an amazing team, many who have worked here for years and are loved by SB locals.   Duane and Katie are fabulous and today as I write this Haley is working!   She just made me an amazing margarita.  \n\nNow, why five stars? Because I come here so freakin' much.   How could I ever knock off a star for a place I frequent many times in a month.  SB falls short in the sports bar department and O'Malleys has TV's in abundance!  Inside, on the patio and now out front on State Street.   Whether you love football, Dodger games or European Soccer they have it on.   If you are visiting SB you might have noticed it is not uncommon to pay $16 for a drink, not O'Malley's, I don't know how many times I got my bill and said \"we ordered five drinks\" and heard them respond \"yes, they are all on there\".  As a tourist you might find O'Malley's to be a little unkept for the fancy SB vibe you are used to, but come back on your next visit, and then your next.   I'm sure you will embrace it as I do."
    }
  ]
}

      "review_date": "2014-05-09 15:00:38",
      "review_text": "Katie Teall is an ANGEL!!!  I made a wedding cake for the daughter of a very close High School friend and the Fondant I bought (FondArt) was horrible. We ended up having the most beautiful cake and thanks to Katie.  Katie also build the cake, putting all three tiers together.  Then explained to me how to decorate it.  She told me to get a photo of the container of her fondant because she had tried all the different brands and that was the best of them all.  She said that mine was impossible to work with since it was too dry!  Katie is a walking ANGEL.  I love her, love her and love her. I am a bit of a dive bar connoisseur and O'Malley's falls short or more accurately elevates above the standard of dive bar.   Mostly for the lack of bar flys sitting at the counter at 11:00am.  \n\nThey have an amazing team, many who have worked here for years and are loved by SB locals.   Duane and Katie are fabulous and today as I write this Haley is working!   She just made me an amazing margarita.  \n\nNow, why five stars? Because I come here so freakin' much.   How could I ever knock off a star for a place I frequent many times in a month.  SB falls short in the sports bar department and O'Malleys has TV's in abundance!  Inside, on the patio and now out front on State Street.   Whether you love football, Dodger games or European Soccer they have it on.   If you are visiting SB you might have noticed it is not uncommon to pay $16 for a drink, not O'Malley's, I don't know how many times I got my bill and said \"we ordered five drinks\" and heard them respond \"yes, they are all on there\".  As a tourist you might find O'Malley's to be a little unkept for the fancy SB vibe you are used to, but come back on your next visit, and then your next.   I'm sure you will embrace it as I do."
    }
  ]
}

      "review_text": "Ordered a white cake with buttercream. When I placed the order they suggested a light lemon cream filling which I went with. It was beyond perfect. Light fluffy buttercream, moist cake, and the filling was a perfect match up. Yep, I will be back!"
    },
    {
      "review_stars": 5.0,
      "review_date": "2014-08-07 19:34:34",
      "review_text": "Katie baked the wedding cake of my dreams. It came out exactly as I wanted and was delicious. We had three tiers: two were red velvet and one was vanilla custard cake with fresh raspberries. I am very happy with our decision to choose her."
    },
    {
      "review_stars": 5.0,
      "review_date": "2014-05-09 15:00:38",
      "review_text": "Katie Teall is an ANGEL!!!  I made a wedding cake for the daughter of a very close High School friend and the Fondant I bought (FondArt) was horrible.  I spent about 7 hours kneading it and rolling it, and no matter what I did when I covered a tier of the cake it cracked.  I was so stressed that decided to go to Montecito Confections to see if I could buy Fondant there.  I got there and asked Katie Teall the sweet adorable, British owner if she could help me.  she explained that she sold the store and the rest of her Fondant was for the last 15 wedding cakes that she had to deliver during the summer.  She must have seen my face of stress, exhaustion, just lost, and asked:  How big is your cake?  I told her and she said:  Do you want me to cover it in Fondant for you?  I jumped to hug her and kiss her and hug her and kissed her some more.\n\nI came home and the mother of the bride carried the bottom tier and we went back to Montecito Confections to be saved by Katie.  We arrived and she said where is the rest of the cake?  I did not want to take advantage so we just took the biggest tier.  She said:  Bring it!\n\nHome we went after hugging Katie and kissing her some more and got help and left with two more tiers.  Katie my angel covered the three tiers!!! She was my angel.  The mother of the bride broke in tears, I guess she was worried that I was never going to serve the wedding cake.  These were tears of relief!  We ended up having the most beautiful cake and thanks to Katie.  Katie also build the cake, putting all three tiers together.  Then explained to me how to decorate it.  She told me to get a photo of the container of her fondant because she had tried all the different brands and that was the best of them all.  She said that mine was impossible to work with since it was too dry!  Katie is a walking ANGEL.  I love her, love her and love her.  All the kisses and hugs are not enough to thank her for saving the wedding cake and so much more."
    }
  ]
}

      "review_date": "2021-12-12 04:20:43",
      "review_text": "Husband and I walked by Petit Valentien this afternoon and the Ethiopian lunch dishes we saw on the patio looked great, so we stopped in for dinner about 30 minutes ago. We weren't in a huge rush, but we didn't have hours to dine, because I had dough proofing at home and needed to attend to it. Hubby walked in and checked in with waitress and came out saying we should take any seat we wanted and she'd be right out with menus. So, we sat next to the Xmas tree on the patio and waited... and waited... and waited.\n\nWe figured she couldn't see us so we moved right next to the front door, where she couldn't miss us. After waiting several minutes, I decided we would wait 5 more minutes and then find somewhere else for dinner. After 3 minutes, a 30-something brunette waitress came and dropped off menus. I let her know the table was wobbly and she said she'd bring a block for it (which she never did). Oddly, I detected a twinge of attitude from the waitress with that exchange... not sure why, but there was an element of nastiness in her tone. She also turned on the table-side heater, which was very effective, if somewhat atmosphere-killing, because of its very bright coils.\n\nI pulled up Yelp to look at the pics of the entrees and we settled on what we wanted to order. After about 5 more minutes, the waitress returned and informed us that dinner would take longer here than other restaurants. I let her know I was proofing dough at home and if we ordered immediately, how long would it take. She replied that if we ordered faster, the food would come faster. (Duh! Crazy how that works!) Again, a twinge of nastiness.\n\nHubby and I heard the specials and I asked her to repeat the sides on one of the specials. Attitude was ramping up from her. I asked her what her favorite item on the menu was and she replied, \"I can't say. You're the one who's going to eat it, not me! The chef wouldn't even tell you.\" \n\nI didn't dare ask another question, because she was in full beeeyatch mode. We both ordered off the regular menu. Then, she said it would be 20 minutes and we ordered wine. Before she left, I asked the waitress if she could please ask the chef not to hold the entree until we finished the appetizer... just to put it all in at once. Her response? \"The chef doesn't need to be micromanaged like that.\" And that, my Yelp friends, was my limit to the abuse I was going to take from this witch of a waitress.\n\nI smiled and said thank you, but we aren't going to stay. She said okay, opened the door, walked into the restaurant, and I could hear her behind me exclaiming with a groan as she entered, \"Oh my Gaaaaawwwdd.\"\n\nGood thing they're in a tourist zone, because Petit Valentien can have a fresh supply of customers the waitress can abuse. As for this local, I'd recommend one of our other many fine dining establishments and give this one a wide berth, if service is important to you.\n\nTwo last comments: First, we noticed the restaurant had a Help Wanted sign posted, looking for servers, which could hint that maybe the attitude starts at the top and they have a hard time keeping servers. Second, I noticed another one of the local Yelp Elite crew (and other reviewers) also commented on the rude and inattentive service here. Seems to be a trend and unfortunately, it was our unlucky turn to experience it tonight."

    },

      "review_stars": 5.0,

      "review_text": "Amazing experience with a variety of Ethiopian flavors giving it the right touch. A story in flavors you need to experience. Lovely location feels like your in another world.  \nGreat service."
